虽然他知道张云实力很强，但那可是三位金丹期，尤其是最后出现的高个黑袍人，给他的感觉很可能是金丹期中的顶级高手。
同时忍不住攥紧双拳，咬着嘴唇满眼不甘，只恨他自己没有足够实力！
“你们这两只小老鼠，想跑到哪里去？”
这时，一道突兀的声音忽然自上方传来。
徐鸣和吴小胖都是脸色一变，抬头看向上方。
只见两侧的大树上，正有两位黑袍人眼含玩味盯着他们。
“逃？在本少面前，你们想逃到哪去？”
一声冷笑，两位黑袍人同时从大树上跃下，那手中分别握着一把剑朝他们劈了下来。
但还是给黑袍人剑落地掀起尘灰蕴含的劲气，震得朝两侧踉跄倒退。
退了几步的徐鸣稳住身形，看着那冷笑开口的黑袍人忽然认出了什么，身躯一颤。双眼涌现出刻骨铭心的恨意，怒吼道：“林世！你是林世！！”
冷笑黑袍人闻言一怔，嘴角勾起一丝弧度，索性也不遮掩了，直接掀开帽子，露出了一张俊逸的青年面庞。
看到这张面庞的瞬间，徐鸣双眼仿佛要喷出火般，整张脸都因怒火涨红起来。
这愤怒模样让旁边吴小胖有些错愕。
认识以来，他还是第一次看到这样的徐鸣！
另一位黑袍人见俊逸青年露出模样，脸色微微一变。
林世摆手，一副睥睨姿态看向徐鸣和吴小胖：“两个将死之人，是不可能将消息传出去的！”
“你去把那小胖子宰了。这废物……”
他盯着暴怒的徐鸣，仿佛看着一头美味的猎物般舔了舔嘴角，“由本少来再废一次！！”

黑袍人见状没再多说，当即持剑冲向吴小胖。
吴小胖脸色一变，连忙从储物戒指里取出一把刀横挡。
刀剑相撞，火花溅起的同时一股气劲在其上爆发。
吴小胖身躯一晃，整个人直接被震退而出。
一连退了十多步才稳住身子，抬头看向面前黑袍人，眼中掠过一丝意外。
先前出现的三位黑袍人个个都是金丹期，他还以为这也是，没想到……
没来及多想，黑袍人已是再次持剑杀向他。
“筑基期而已，我未必不能一战！”
吴小胖见状一咬牙，不打算逃跑，直接抄起刀迎了上去。
“废物，没想到会再遇见本少吧？”
林世看着徐鸣冷笑开口：“本少之前说过，你逃不掉的。上一次有你爹娘帮你殿后，让你侥幸跑了。这一次，你不可能再逃得掉！！“

> Chapter 23 Enemy (Page 1)
Although he knew that Zhang Yun was very strong, they were three golden elixir stage players, especially the tall black-robed man who appeared at the end, giving him the impression that they were probably the top masters in the golden elixir stage.
At the same time, he couldn't help clenching his fists, biting his lips, and his eyes were full of dissatisfaction, only hating that he didn't have enough strength!
"Where do you two little mice want to run to?"
At this time, a sudden sound suddenly came from above.
Xu Ming and Wu Xiaopang's expressions changed and they looked up.
They saw two men in black robes staring at them with amusement in the big trees on both sides.
"Escape? Where do you want to escape in front of me?"
With a sneer, the two men in black robes jumped down from the big tree at the same time, holding a sword in their hands and slashed at them.
But the black-robed man's sword still stirred up so much energy from the dust that it fell to the ground, causing him to stumble backwards on both sides.
Xu Ming, who took a few steps back, stabilized his figure, looked at the man in black robe who sneered and suddenly recognized something, and his body trembled. His eyes filled with unforgettable hatred, and he roared angrily: "Lin Shi! You are Lin Shi!!"
The sneering black-robed man was startled when he heard the words, and the corners of his mouth curved up. He simply did not cover it up and directly lifted his hat, revealing a handsome young face.
The moment he saw this face, Xu Ming's eyes seemed to burst out with fire, and his whole face turned red with anger.
This angry look made Fatty Wu next to him a little stunned.
This was the first time he saw Xu Ming like this since they met!
When the other man in black robe saw the appearance of the handsome young man, his expression changed slightly.
Lin Shi waved his hand and looked at Xu Ming and Wu Xiaopang with a look of disdain: "It is impossible for two dying people to spread the news!"
"Go and kill that little fat guy. This waste..."
He stared at the furious Xu Ming and licked the corner of his mouth as if he were looking at a delicious prey, "Young master, let me destroy you again!!"
When the man in black robe saw this, he didn't say anything more and immediately rushed towards Wu Xiaopang with his sword.
Wu Xiaopang's expression changed, and he quickly took out a knife from his storage ring to block it.
The swords collided, sparks flew and a burst of energy exploded on them.
Wu Xiaopang's body swayed and he was knocked back.
He took more than ten steps back before he regained his balance. He looked up at the man in black robes in front of him, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
The three men in black robes who appeared earlier were all at the Golden Core stage. He thought this was the same, but he didn't expect...
Before he had time to think about it, the man in black robe was already attacking him with his sword again.
"It's just the foundation building period, I may not be able to fight!"
Wu Xiaopang gritted his teeth when he saw this. He didn't intend to run away, so he directly picked up the knife and faced him.
"Trash, you didn't expect to meet me again, did you?"
Lin Shi looked at Xu Ming and sneered: "I said before that you can't escape. Last time, your parents helped you to defend the rear, so you escaped by chance. This time, you can't escape again!!"
